fields.description:
Discovered while implementing e9d5-c850-d505-4a5a (typed reconciler mutation
payload contracts, ADR 0107). Two producers construct (outbound, update)
Mutation payloads with different shapes:

- differ.py's older _compute_mutations_emit_both path emits a flat,
  unwrapped "changed" dict directly as Mutation.payload.
- outbound_pass.py / binding_walk.py wrap the same information as
  {"changed_fields": {...}, "comments": [...], "labels": [...], "links": [...]}.

ADR 0107's typed OutboundUpdatePayload contract standardizes on the wrapped
shape (changed_fields); the flat legacy shape from differ.py's older path
would fail typed validation today. This is a pre-existing inconsistency,
NOT introduced by e9d5 -- e9d5 only documents it (see the corpus README and
e9d5's ticket comment recording approved intentional deltas) and does not
reconcile it, since producer rewiring is ADR 0107's deferred "Cut" step and
out of e9d5's own scope (AC7).

Suggested follow-up: decide (a) which shape is canonical going forward, and
(b) migrate differ.py's _compute_mutations_emit_both to emit the wrapped
changed_fields shape so both producers agree before any producer is
rewired to construct OutboundUpdatePayload directly (that "Cut" step is a
separate, later ticket).

Acceptance criteria:
- A decision is recorded on which shape is canonical for (outbound, update)
  Mutation payloads.
- differ.py's _compute_mutations_emit_both and outbound_pass.py /
  binding_walk.py agree on payload shape, verified by a test asserting both
  producers emit the same normalized shape for an equivalent update.
